## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request links an issue, or explains why none is needed.
- [ ] An ADR is linked if the change alters the definition format, an operation's result, the public API, error codes, core dependencies, supported versions or scope (see CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Behaviour changes come with conformance vectors whose expected results come from a cited source or an independent generator, not from fiscalclock's own output.
- [ ] No expected result in an existing vector changed, or the linked issue explains why.
- [ ] Every new factual claim in code, docs or tests has a source link or a reproducible check, and time-sensitive facts carry "as of <date>".
- [ ] Documentation (README, spec, wiki) is updated where behaviour changed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under "Unreleased" for any user-visible change.
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits and carry no AI or model attribution lines.
